transcript: Speaker A: ये क्या है? मैंने कहा था structured shoulders. ये तो बिल्कुल loose है। [What is this? I said structured shoulders. This is completely loose.] Speaker B: Madam, आपने जो measurement दी थी, उसी के according सिला गया है। [Madam, it has been stitched according to the measurement you gave.] Speaker A: इनकी यही problem है। ये लोग सिर्फ stitching जानते हैं। Fashion, structure, silhouette ये concepts इन्हें समझ नहीं आते। हमें designer boutique जाना चाहिए था। [This is their problem. They only know stitching. They don't understand concepts like fashion, structure, silhouette. We should have gone to a designer boutique.] Speaker B: Madam, please tell me exactly what you need. You haven't come to the wrong place. You are just not able to explain it properly. I have a booklet of all the designs, please check which design you want, I will take your measurements and stitch it for you. Please don't worry at all, you will get the best results. Did you do coaching?] Speaker B: नहीं madam, इतना काम रहता है, coaching जाने का time कहाँ है? मेरे clients अच्छे घर से हैं, पढ़े-लिखे लोग हैं। उनके लिए English सीखनी पड़ी। English Seekho app. ₹1 का trial. [No madam, there is so much work, where is the time to go to coaching? My clients are from good families, educated people. Had to learn English for them. English Seekho app. 1 rupee trial.] Speaker B: रोज़ सुबह-शाम 15 minute. AI coach से practice. गलत बोलता था, सुधार देती थी। कभी judge नहीं किया, कभी मज़ाक नहीं उड़ाया। 3 महीने पहले madam, आप जैसी clients आकर यही बोलती थीं, 'इन्हें क्या पता silhouette क्या होता है।' अब खुद सीधा बात करती हैं। [Every morning and evening, 15 minutes. Practice with AI coach. If I spoke wrong, she corrected it. Never judged, never made fun. 3 months ago madam, clients like you would come and say, 'What do they know what silhouette is.' Now they talk directly themselves.] Speaker A: App का नाम क्या बताया? मैं भी download करूँगी। [What did you say the name of the app was? I will also download it.] Speaker B: English Seekho app madam. ₹1 का trial. [English Seekho app madam. 1 rupee trial.] Speaker C: Install Now पर click करो और अभी English Seekho app download करो। [Click on Install Now and download the English Seekho app now.]
